maria-peopleops: Heads up — candidate Maya L (Data Infra) has asked for an off-band package. Band F1 top is $200,000; candidate is asking $220,000 + $12k sign-on + relocation assistance. Asking for 2026-06-01 start. Need routing for comp + relocation.

vince-recruiter: Maya has a deadline from competitor next week. If we can offer 220k + relocation we close. Can hiring team stretch and can finance cover relocation?

elaine-hiringmgr: Maya is high priority. I can approve up to $210k from my hiring authority. Anything beyond requires director + finance signoff. Relocation needs people ops approval too.

sam-finance: Cost center? Is sign-on one-time cash or equity refresh? Relocation is usually from the relocation budget. If we cover delta above $210k, need approval from Dir Eng and confirmation of hiring cushion. Payroll note: off-cycle sign-on or relocation reimbursements require docs 5 business days before payout.

maria-peopleops: Okay running the approval. Use this command:

```/approvals new candidate=MayaL role=Data_Infra base=220000 band=F1 request_type=comp-and-relocation signon=12000 relocation=true start_request=2026-06-01```

hr-approvals-bot: Approval request 1799004321 created. Pending approvals: elaine-hiringmgr, dir-peopleops, sam-finance. Routing ETA 4 business hours.

vince-recruiter: Quick ask: can we do partial relocation advance to help candidate move earlier? Some candidates need funds ahead of start. @payroll-bot ?

payroll-bot: Payroll can advance relocation up to 50% as a one-time grossed-up payment, requires signed offer + I-9 + W-4 4 business days before payout. Advances are taxable and will be reflected on first pay stub.

elaine-hiringmgr: I can approve $220k to close this candidate if finance confirms funding source. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

olivia-peopleops: (from people ops) I can approve relocation assistance policy exception for this role if hiring signs and finance covers the comp delta. Need relocation plan in the offer letter.

sam-finance: Confirmed: finance can cover $10k delta above $210k from ENG-INFRA-RELIEF pool and relocation up to $8k from relocation budget. Sign-on $12k needs Dir Eng approval for the remaining $2k. Routing to Dir Eng now.

hr-approvals-bot: Request 1799004321 status: PENDING (elizabeth-direng, olivia-peopleops, sam-finance).

elizabeth-direng: Approved the remaining $2k sign-on and the comp delta. Confirmed funding from ENG-PLATFORM-01.

hr-approvals-bot: Request 1799004321 status: APPROVED (elaine-hiringmgr, olivia-peopleops, sam-finance, elizabeth-direng).

vince-recruiter: Offer sent at 1799004510. Candidate given deadline 2026-05-28 to sign to keep 2026-06-01 start. Included relocation breakdown and advance option in offer note.

maria-peopleops: Filing updated in Greenhouse and approvals tracker. Note: relocation advances processed after signed offer and completed tax forms.

payroll-bot: Payroll cleared fast-pay for relocation advance. Candidate can receive 50% advance if signed by 2026-05-27 and documents received by 2026-05-27. Standard payroll on-cycle earliest would have been 2026-06-15.

vince-recruiter: Candidate accepted verbally, requested the relocation advance. Asked to sign by Friday.

maria-peopleops: Closing loop once acceptance is in writing. Thanks team :tada:
